title: It’s Becoming Clear Why Black Holes Never Run Out of Fuel - WIRED
summary_full: It’s Becoming Clear Why Black Holes Never Run Out of Fuel  WIREDJames Webb Space Telescope discovers how black holes feed themselves  SpaceJWST captures rare glimpse of early black hole growing inside network of young galaxies  Phys.orgThe James Webb Space Telescope spent nearly eight hours staring into NGC 4696, a galaxy 145 million light-years away, and watched a river of cool gas pour into an 800-light-year disk spinning at 600 kilometers per second, feeding the supermassive black  Space DailyNASA’s James Webb catches a supermassive black hole feeding  ScienceDaily
